arguments.rule_content:
rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Suspicious_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons (high false positive rate on packed .NET)"
        author = "SOC Team"
        confidence = "medium"
        false_positives = ["Packed legitimate .NET applications, Microsoft update modules"]
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } 
        $b = "CryptStringProtect" wide
        $c = "RtlDecompressBuffer" wide
    condition:
        all of them
}
